New Residential Developments Of Any Kind Are not Permitted Within The Floodway. Adus Equal Or Less Than 500 Square Feet May Be Conditionally Permitted Within The Floodway (Public Hearing), And Adus Are Permitted Outside The Floodway. Outside The Floodway Residential Development Is Permitted Conditionally (With Public Hearing).

New Residential Developments Are Only Permitted Within The Crossett Hill And Cemetery Sub-Areas. In Both, Single-Family Dwellings Are Permitted But Only As Part Of A Pud.
